caption: The drawing depicts two spurs, each composed of a brown leather strap with metal elements. The leather straps are a reddish-brown color, with one of the straps featuring an embossed or carved decorative figure on a rounded segment. Both spurs include round, silver-colored metal conchos with engraved patterns attached to the leather, along with other metal fittings. Each spur has an angled U-shaped metal arm fixed to the leather strap, ending in a circular rowel (a star-shaped, rotating wheel) made from silver or gray metal. The background of the image is plain and off-white, highlighting the details and coloration of the spurs.
title: Silver Dollar Spurs
